articles.title: v8.0.0-rc.20-dev.1: chore(release): bump to 8.0.0-rc.20 (#30838)
articles.summary: Version 8.0.0-rc.19 → 8.0.0-rc.20 . Merging this PR publishes the release. The main change: the ORM's commands run on @prisma/cli-engine 0.9.0, the engine the prisma CLI 8.0.0-rc.25 ships ( #30835 ). A piped ORM command now prints tab-separated data lines on stdout; scripts that read JSON must pass --json . This release lets prisma/composer and prisma/prisma-cli drop their engine 0.7.0 pins. What to review Release notes: docs/releases/v8.0.0-rc.20.md , which becomes the GitHub Release body. It covers 11 merged PRs: 7 breaking changes, 7 features, 3 fixes. articles.summary: v8.0.0-rc.20 ORM commands run on @prisma/cli-engine 0.9.0, so a piped command prints tab-separated data lines and JSON needs --json . A type alias in PSL can set @default , @onCreate and @onUpdate , and the contract stores each column's real type instead of the alias name. Postgres migrations can rename, move and remove namespaces, and can change a relation's actions or a primary key. A failed migration check now names the object it expected. articles.title: pnpm 11.28.8
articles.summary: Patch Changes The standalone @pnpm/exe builds now embed Node.js 26.12.1. The previously embedded Node.js 26.0.0 still trusted the certificate authority intermediates that Node.js distrusted in October 2026, so a standalone pnpm accepted TLS certificates issued under them. articles.title: openclaw 2026.10.6
articles.summary: 2026.10.6 Highlights Patched Node runtime required: OpenClaw now requires Node 24.22.1+ on the 24 line or 26.12.1+ on the 26 line, which reject TLS chains signed with the compromised certificate keys addressed in the October 2026 Node.js security releases. Docker images ship Node 24.22.1, installers select the patched runtimes, and openclaw update refuses with recovery guidance before installing on an older Node instead of breaking the running install. Source builds now pin pnpm 12.15.0. ( #179992 ) Thanks @joshavant . Safer updates and recovery: package swaps now refuse unsafe service...
